title: Interest post-balance operation
description: This event occurs when a redemption or registration needs to happen based on the post-balance feature of product interest management.

program_id.title: Program identification
program_id.description: Program ID to which the account belongs within your organization.

balance_id.title: Balance ID
balance_id.description: Unique balance identifier defined by Pismo.

interest_plan_id.title: Interest Plan ID identifier
interest_plan_id.description: A custom identifier string that indicates the interest plan to be used in the rate calculations.

asset_id.title: Asset ID
asset_id.description: Unique asset identifier defined by Pismo.

account_id.title: Account identifier
account_id.description: A custom account ID string that uniquely identifies the account within your organization.

amount.title: Registration or redemption Amount based on request_type

document_number.title: Customer document number
document_number.description: Number of post balance owner's legal document

customer_name.title: Customer name
customer_name.description: Name of post balance owner. Can be a company or an individual.

customer_type.title: Entity type
customer_type.description: Legal nature of post balance owner

request_type.title: Entity type
request_type.description: Type of request for banking to call

has_asset_registration.title: Has Asset Registration
has_asset_registration.description: Indicates if the interest deposit must be registered as a asset
